elements.content: Master the core scientific vocabulary and collocations for this topic (10 items):

items.definition: the chemical processes that occur within a living organism to maintain life.
a steroid hormone regulating stress responses and metabolism.
items.example: Drinking coffee on an empty stomach can elevate cortisol levels.

items.definition: an antioxidant compound found abundantly in plant foods.
items.example: Coffee is a major dietary source of protective polyphenols.

items.definition: how responsive cells are to insulin.
items.example: Improved insulin sensitivity aids glucose uptake in muscle tissue.

items.definition: a class of organic compounds that are fatty acids or insoluble in water.
items.example: Coffee compounds stimulate lipid oxidation during exercise.

items.definition: having a biological effect on living tissue.
items.example: Bioactive polyphenols exhibit strong anti-inflammatory properties.

items.definition: relating to glands that secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream.
items.example: Caffeine interacts with the human endocrine system.

items.definition: the maintenance of something in its original state or in good condition.
items.example: Lean muscle preservation is crucial during weight loss.

items.definition: the exertion of a modifying or controlling influence on something.
items.example: Hormonal modulation influences appetite and energy levels.

items.definition: the tendency toward a relatively stable equilibrium between interdependent elements.
items.example: The body continuously strives for metabolic homeostasis.
